searchText: <paperun> Is it fair to say that the main takeaway here is that a smaller avg block time on eth1 should be used for fork estimates? It could be used to increase matching between the real TTD hit and the expectations. But the biggest noise is coming from PoW chain fluctuations which seem to be difficult to deal with and we likely have to accept this uncertainty. <zilm13> yeah and to be ready for terminal block in 3 days instead of 7. in the worst case (re @paperun: Is it fair to say that the main takeaway here is that a smaller avg block time on eth1 should be used for fork estimates?)
